# Spell batch #522 fixtures

[Provenance](provenance.json) records 100 exact ticket roots, 27 recursive linked Spell context files and 28 casting-class lookup files, all byte-identical to the pinned Foundry v11.11 checkout. The context files supply parser link and class-tag lookups; they are unreviewed dependencies, not additional candidates or admitted content. The content directory retains a marker for fresh-checkout parser reproduction.

[Preview](preview.json) reproduces the bounded public import with checked description Notes. [Binding preview](binding-preview.json) preserves the 100 roots and their recursive parsed Spell context from verified full extraction, so the tests can replay every current content, mapping, evidence and notice binding. Both are held-content evidence: neither creates a running Effect, admits content, publishes a Catalog Release or activates a deployment.

[Catalog tests](../../catalog/spells-522.test.ts) pin exact identities and bytes, source metadata, independently outstanding mechanics, enforced notice holds, drift invalidation and the public resolver's recorded-Spell behavior. [Saved-sheet tests](../../../convex/catalogSpells522.integration.test.ts) install Fox's Cunning and Fly only in an isolated Character catalog, then exercise Wizard browsing, member recording/removal, source preservation, casting calculations, client/server preview parity, and organization/campaign authorization. Their legal assessments remain unresolved throughout. [Batch report](../../../docs/catalog-import/spells-522.md) records dispositions and evidence limits.
